examples.chinese: 我爸爸、媽媽有三個孩子，我最愛看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba, māma yǒu sān ge háizi, wǒ zuì ài kànshū.
examples.english: My parents have three kids. I like to read the most.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
examples.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: 李先生有三個孩子，一個兒子，兩個女兒。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng yǒu sān ge háizi, yí ge érzi, liǎng ge nǚ'ér.
examples.english: Mr. Li has three children: one son and two daughters.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子還太小，不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi hái tài xiǎo, bù néng hē jiǔ.
examples.english: This child is still too young, cannot drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?
examples.english: Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

items.wordHook: 孩(baby) + 子(child) → a young one: 孩子(child).

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 聽說下星期一我們要用別的教室，你知道是哪間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xià xīngqīyī wǒmen yào yòng bié de jiàoshì, nǐ zhīdào shì nǎ jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: I heard that next Monday we will use a different classroom; do you know which classroom it is?

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
examples.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

items.wordHook: Listen (聽) to someone speak (說) and you hear of (聽說) the thing.

examples.chinese: 你看，飛機起飛了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, fēijī qǐfēi le!
examples.english: Look, the airplane has taken off!

examples.chinese: 十點了，飛機快(要)起飛了。
examples.pinyin: Shí diǎn le, fēijī kuài (yào) qǐfēi le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock; the plane is about to take off.

examples.chinese: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
examples.pinyin: Bānjī qǐfēi qián, fúwù rényuán dōu huì wèi lǚkè shuōmíng yīng zhùyì de ānquán guīdìng.
examples.english: Before the flight takes off, the service staff will explain the safety regulations that should be noted to the passengers.

examples.chinese: 我希望明年可以去英國學英文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng míngnián kěyǐ qù Yīngguó xué Yīngwén.
examples.english: I hope to go to England to study English next year.

examples.chinese: 好，希望老師可以幫我。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xīwàng lǎoshī kěyǐ bāng wǒ.
examples.english: Okay, I hope the teacher has some good ideas.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 我希望以後可以去他家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu kěyǐ qù tā jiā wán.
examples.english: I hope that in the future I can go to his house to have fun.

examples.chinese: 晚安！希望你有個好夢。
examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.
examples.english: Good night! I hope you have a good dream.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.
examples.english: Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

items.wordHook: 希(hope) + 望(to look forward) → looking forward in hope: 希望 means to hope.

examples.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我還沒去過日本，今年可能有機會去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qù guo Rìběn, jīnnián kěnéng yǒu jīhuì qù.
examples.english: I have not yet been to Japan; this year I might have a chance to go.

examples.chinese: 今天辦公室的冷氣不冷，可能冷氣機有問題。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bàngōngshì de lěngqì bù lěng, kěnéng lěngqìjī yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: Today the air conditioning in the office is not cold; there might be a problem with the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會當了我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ děi yònggōng yīdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì dāngle wǒ.
examples.english: This course is very hard; I need to study a bit harder, otherwise the teacher might flunk me.

examples.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會被當。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ děi yònggōng yīdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì bèi dāng.
examples.english: This course is very hard; I need to study a bit harder, otherwise the teacher might flunk (me).

examples.chinese: 別在房子裡燒東西，要不然可能會把房子也燒了。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài fángzi lǐ shāo dōngxi, yàobùrán kěnéng huì bǎ fángzi yě shāo le.
examples.english: Don't burn things inside the house, otherwise you might burn the house down too.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 今明兩天的天氣可能從晴天轉雨天，出門前記得帶傘。
examples.pinyin: Jīn míng liǎng tiān de tiānqì kěnéng cóng qíngtiān zhuǎn yǔtiān, chūmén qián jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: The weather today and tomorrow may turn from sunny to rainy; remember to bring an umbrella before going out.

examples.chinese: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié chuān zhe tuōxié qù cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng, yàobùrán biérén kěnéng rènwéi nǐ bù dǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: You'd better not wear slippers to attend a formal event, otherwise others might think you don't understand manners.

examples.chinese: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshì wàngjì dōngxi bù jiànde shì yīnwèi gèxìng míhú, yě kěnéng yǔ jiànkāng yǒuguān.
examples.english: Always forgetting things is not necessarily because of an absentminded personality; it may also be related to health.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 冷氣機裡的網子要常拆下來洗，不然可能吹出髒空氣。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì jī lǐ de wǎngzi yào cháng chāi xiàlái xǐ, bùrán kěnéng chuī chū zāng kōngqì.
examples.english: The filter net in the air conditioner should often be taken apart and washed, otherwise it might blow out dirty air.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
examples.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

examples.chinese: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài tā de shídài suǒ nǔlì de jiéguǒ, dōu kěnéng huì zài wèilái kāihuā jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The results of scientists' efforts in their era may all bear fruit in the future.

examples.chinese: 談生意時千萬別打斷客戶的話，不然做生意的機會很可能就斷了。
examples.pinyin: Tán shēngyì shí qiānwàn bié dǎduàn kèhù de huà, bùrán zuò shēngyì de jīhuì hěn kěnéng jiù duàn le.
examples.english: When discussing business, never interrupt the client, otherwise the opportunity to do business may very well be broken off.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
examples.pinyin: Jiēdài kèhù shì yǒu jìqiǎo de, nòng bù hǎo kěnéng huì diū le shēngyì.
examples.english: Receiving clients requires skill; if you don't handle it well, you might lose the business.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
examples.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

items.wordHook: 可(can) + 能(can) → 'can can': it's possible → 可能 means maybe.

examples.chinese: 十分鐘以前我給他打了一個電話。
examples.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐqián wǒ gěi tā dǎ le yí ge diànhuà.
examples.english: Ten minutes ago, I gave him a phone call.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 便利商店不遠，從我家過去只要五分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn bù yuǎn, cóng wǒ jiā guòqù zhǐyào wǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The convenience store is not far; going over from my home takes only five minutes.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 這班捷運一共有十節車廂(chēxiāng, railway carriage)。我們的中文課一節是五十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān jiéyùn yígòng yǒu shí jié chēxiāng. / Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè yì jié shì wǔshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: This MRT train has ten carriages in total. / One session of our Chinese class is fifty minutes.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 這種麵不必煮，只要倒進熱水、泡幾分鐘，就可以吃了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng miàn bùbì zhǔ, zhǐyào dào jìn rèshuǐ, pào jǐ fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ chī le.
examples.english: This kind of noodles doesn't need to be boiled; just pour hot water over them, let them brew for a few minutes, and they're ready to eat.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
examples.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: 我只想喝茶，別的飲料我都不想喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hē chá, bié de yǐnliào wǒ dōu bù xiǎng hē.
examples.english: I only want to drink tea; I don't want to drink any other beverages.

examples.chinese: 學校附近有很多飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: There are many beverage shops near the school.

examples.chinese: 商品想賣得好，就得準備一筆廣告費，多多宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Shāngpǐn xiǎng mài de hǎo, jiù děi zhǔnbèi yī bǐ guǎnggào fèi, duōduō xuānchuán.
examples.english: If you want products to sell well, you have to prepare a sum for advertising expenses and promote them more.

examples.pinyin: Jiā zhōng de fèichē kě sòng dào qìchē xiūlǐ gōngchǎng huíshōu, duōduōshǎoshǎo néng mài diǎn qián.
examples.english: The derelict car at home can be sent to an auto repair shop for recycling; you can more or less sell it for some money.

examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.
